headline: Soleon Explained
title: Soleon Guide | The Golden Form Helion Turns Into | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Soleon is the Light form of Helion, and you cannot catch it in the wild. Helion turns into Soleon during battle when it uses its ultimate, Helios Judgment. That skill hits with a power of one hundred sixty seven and costs no energy. Soleon is a Light damage dealer with very high attack, so keep Helion alive long enough to fire the ultimate. Are you team Helion or team Lunara? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Soleon only exists as Helion's battle form
The ultimate that makes the change
Keep Helion alive to fire it
